userStories.title: Create BEV C05 Performance Assessment with Supervisor Competency Rubrics
userStories.description: Develop Performance Assessment (PA) document for BEV C05 supervisory unit with detailed rubric-based marking framework covering 5 supervisor competencies and 20+ workplace scenario-based questions. Align all assessment criteria to CoCU C05 supervisor role requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: PA.md includes 5 supervisor competencies (briefing/toolbox talks, training delivery, SHE monitoring, team coordination, documentation) each with 4-level rubric (Novice 0-25% / Intermediate 26-50% / Proficient 51-75% / Advanced 76-100%)
Minimum 20 scenario-based questions (each 200-300 words) reflecting realistic workplace scenarios with 100+ word sample answers demonstrating expected supervisor knowledge and decision-making
Total mark allocation: 100 marks with rubric-weighted distribution (30% briefing, 25% training, 20% SHE, 15% coordination, 10% documentation) and documented pass threshold
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-05/PA.md (use markdown tables for rubrics, numbered scenarios with clear answer schemes and mark guidance)
Validation: grep -c 'Scenario [0-9]' bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-05/PA.md to confirm minimum 20 scenarios; verify total marks via grep '= [0-9]* marks' sum to 100
Test alignment: grep 'CoCU C05' bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-05/PA.md to confirm all competencies reference specific CoCU C05 supervisor competency sections

userStories.title: Create BEV C03 Thermal System Knowledge Assessment with Scenario-Based Diagnostics
userStories.description: Create a comprehensive Knowledge Assessment document for BEV C03 (Thermal Management Systems) with scenario-based questions that require learners to diagnose and troubleshoot thermal cooling system failures, aligned with CoCU learning outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create KA.md file with minimum 8 scenario-based questions covering thermal system diagnostics, with each scenario including system state, symptoms, and required diagnosis
Include answer scheme with marking rubric (1-4 points per question) based on CoCU assessment criteria
Ensure 30% of questions test theoretical knowledge and 70% test practical diagnostic scenarios
